## Objective
Generate random roi within content of a wsi.

This script can be used to generate a random ROI in any geometry. The ROI can be imported to qupath for annotation.

### Input
- geojsons with regions to generate the ROI within. E.g.
  - A whole image (add_wsi_annotation.groovy) 
  - Content recognized by a pixel thresholder (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XTb9_OsEHadeK00zn1mO5zQvz4I9exASDEQFf6HTTNY/edit?usp=sharing)
  - Or any geojson with AI output (from already validated model)

### Parameters
- input_dir (folder with geojson files for regions)
- output_dir (folder to output the ROI to - naming strategy: output/random_roi/<image_set_name>_<parent_class>.geojson) 
- parent_class (the classification of the region you'd want to generate the ROI within)
- roi_radius (the radius of the intended roi in pixels)

```{r, functions}

create_random_roi <- function(input_dir, output_dir, parent_class, roi_radius_px, roi_name) {
  
  # Load required libraries
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(jsonlite)
  
  # Increase the maximum object size for GeoJSON reading
  Sys.setenv(OGR_GEOJSON_MAX_OBJ_SIZE = 0)
  
  # Helper function to extract the "name" from a JSON string if applicable
  extract_name <- function(x) {
    if (is.character(x) && grepl("^\\s*\\{", x)) {
      result <- tryCatch({
        parsed <- fromJSON(x)
        if (!is.null(parsed$name)) {
          return(parsed$name)
        } else {
          return(x)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        return(x)
      })
      return(result)
    } else {
      return(x)
    }
  }
  
  # Get the list of input file paths
  input_file_paths <- list.files(input_dir, full.names = TRUE)
  
  # Set seed for reproducibility
  set.seed(42)
  
  # Loop over each file in the input directory
  for (path in input_file_paths) {
    file_name <- basename(path)
    image_name <- sub("_content.*", "", file_name)
    
    # Read the region GeoJSON and set CRS to 0
    region <- st_read(path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
      st_set_crs(0)
    
    # Extract classification names if they are stored as JSON
    region$classification <- sapply(region$classification, extract_name)
    
    # Filter the regions based on the specified parent_class
    region <- region %>% filter(classification == parent_class)
    
    # Sample a random point within the filtered region
    random_point_in_region <- st_sample(region, 1)
    
    # Create a buffer around the random point using the specified ROI radius
    random_roi_in_region <- st_buffer(random_point_in_region, dist = roi_radius_px)
    
    # Create an sf object for the ROI with the given name and classification
    roi_sf <- st_sf(
      data.frame(
        name = roi_name,
        classification = "roi",
        isLocked = TRUE
      ),
      geometry = random_roi_in_region
    )
    
    # Construct the output file path and write the ROI to a GeoJSON file
    output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(image_name, "_roi.geojson"))
    st_write(roi_sf, output_file, quiet = TRUE)
  }
}

```


### Make roi in "content" of in labl_2020_test set
#### Objective
This chunk, creates a random roi per wsi in the "content" regions of slides in the labl_2020_test set.The rois are read into qupath annotated and used to validate the tissue_vs_glass model

#### Input
- <image_name>_content_<annotation_no>.geojson: These files are generated using qupaths pixel thresholder (SOP for creating the thresholder, making detections annotations and exporting them as geojsons are here:  (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XTb9_OsEHadeK00zn1mO5zQvz4I9exASDEQFf6HTTNY/edit?usp=drive_link). 

#### Output
- <image_name>_roi.geojson (Projects/qupath/output/random_roi/labl_2020_test/in_content/)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"
input_dir <- paste0(to_box, "Projects/fe_si_models/content_vs_background/output/export_content/")
output_dir <- paste0(to_box, "Projects/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/random_roi/")
parent_class <- "content"
roi_radius_px <- 2000 #the dist is set by visual inspection to have a good likelihood of including villi and crypts
roi_name <- paste0("random_in_",parent_class)

input_file_paths <- list.files(input_dir, full.names = TRUE)

create_random_roi(input_dir, output_dir, parent_class, roi_radius_px, roi_name)

```
